value.rationale: The 5-by-7 torus is the smallest pair of distinct odd prime cycles of lengths at least five, making a natural finite test bed. Its complete 18-resonance classification and explicit optimal four-, six-, and eight-vertex sensors identify an unexpected arithmetic spatial-budget phase diagram. The skew four-vertex construction resolves a subtle mixed-axis collision that defeats the ordinary rectangular four-sensor set, demonstrating substance beyond counting eigenvalue multiplicities. These exact thresholds are useful in selecting graph sensors and understanding the ill-conditioning risk near resonances.
